name: universe_member
description: One row per instrument in a ranking pool. Snapshot of current index membership (survivorship bias is disclosed).

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Yahoo Finance symbol, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, SAP.DE, BTC-USD.

columns.name: sector
columns.description: GICS sector (US), industry (EU) or category (crypto, e.g. layer-1).

columns.name: country
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the main listing; null for crypto.

columns.name: cik
columns.description: SEC CIK, 10 digits zero-padded; US only.

columns.name: wikipedia_title
columns.description: English Wikipedia article title with underscores; null if none was found.

columns.name: index_membership
columns.description: Pipe-separated source lists, e.g. SP500|NDX, SX5E, EXTRA, CRYPTO_TOP.

columns.name: snapshot_date
columns.description: Date the membership list was read.
